subject: problem with sample size or something else?

messages.author: d7b81046081fd171
messages.subject: problem with sample size or something else?
parts:
Hello Lavaan users,

I am trying to run two sub-populations (individuals with training n=261 individuals without training n=327) through my model. When I run the entire population (n=598) the model converges normally and has a decent fit, when I run the sub-populations, the model either doesn't converge or has a negative variance. Is this because my model has too many variables for the sub-population sample size?

Is it reasonable to include training as a binary co-variate?  Or does anyone have other suggestions?

Below is the r code and full output. Thank you all so much the help you provide!

model <- '

TrustGrp =~ GrpEffic_Select + GrpEffic_Rsc
PerceivedProb =~ PersLikelyCaught + PersLikelyDamage + PersLikelyInjury + PersLikelyKilled
SelfEff =~ HzdChr_SE_Prevent + HzdChr_SE_Escape
PersonalCntrl =~ HzdChr_LocusAvoid + HzdChr_LocusSurvive
SubjNorms =~ SubjNorm_Fam + SubjNorm_Prt
Worry =~ Worry_Invlv + Worry_Killed
CurrentInfo =~ PersAv_CourseCurrKnowl
Threshold =~ PersAv_CourseSuffThresh



SubjNorms ~ SelfEff + IndChar_YrsOfRiding  
Worry ~ SelfEff + TrustGrp + PerceivedProb + PersonalCntrl
CurrentInfo ~ SelfEff + IndChar_YrsOfRiding + IndChar_AgeCat + Worry + SubjNorms
Threshold ~ Worry + SubjNorms + CurrentInfo

'
#To fit the model:
fit <- sem(model, data=TblInput,  estimator = "MLR")
#To view the resutls
summary (fit, standardized=T, fit.measures=T, rsq=T)

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: problem with sample size or something else?
parts:
On 05/14/2013 10:33 PM, Luke strong-cvetich wrote:
> Hello Lavaan users,

> fit, when I run the sub-populations, the model either doesn't converge
> or has a negative variance. Is this because my model has too many
> variables for the sub-population sample size?

Hard to say. I would test the model in each sub-population separately,
and adapt the model if needed.

Often, negative variances are (subtle) symptoms of model misfit.

Yves.
